name: WriteValuesToSpecificColumnsNode
label: Write Values to Specific Columns
description: Writes values to specific columns in a row of an Excel worksheet, useful for populating multiple columns at once.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet where the values will be written.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number where the values will be written.

fields.name: ColumnValuePairs
fields.label: Column-Value Pairs
fields.description: A dictionary mapping column letters/numbers to the values to write (e.g., { "A": "Hello", "B": "World" }).
